**Objective.** Freeze features and release

**Deliverable.** Tag `v1.0.0` on main

**Done when.** After the freeze only pull requests of type fix, docs, test or chore are merged; the tag exists on the remote and its CI run is green

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required by | proposed |
| Depends on | H1 to H8, I2 |
| Due | 2026-12-06 (freeze), 2026-12-09 (tag) |
| Sprint | S4 |
| Effort (S2 baseline) | 0.5 h |
| Priority | M (M must, S should) |

Sources: PF = PROYECTO_FINAL.pdf, A0 = Actividad0_Enunciado_Planteamiento.pdf, A0S = Actividad 0 slides, P1 = Practica 1. Commits of this step end with `Refs: plan K1`.

issues.title: [K2] Build and upload the delivery archive
issues.body:
**Objective.** Build and upload the delivery archive

**Deliverable.** `<GROUP_NAME>.tgz` in Aula Global (or a text file with a Google Drive link if too large)

**Done when.** The archive is a clone at tag `v1.0.0` including `.git`; it contains no virtual environment, built site or secret; `git status` is clean after extraction; the command of F4 succeeds from the extracted copy; SHA-256 recorded; a second member confirms the upload receipt

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required by | PF p. 9 |
| Depends on | K1, J5 |
| Due | 2026-12-10, hour to confirm |
| Sprint | S4 |
| Effort (S2 baseline) | 1.5 h |
| Priority | M (M must, S should) |

Sources: PF = PROYECTO_FINAL.pdf, A0 = Actividad0_Enunciado_Planteamiento.pdf, A0S = Actividad 0 slides, P1 = Practica 1. Commits of this step end with `Refs: plan K2`.

issues.title: [K3] Prepare the defense and the panel vote
issues.body:
**Objective.** Prepare the defense and the panel vote

**Deliverable.** Slides, demonstration script, backup video, question sheet (all inside the repository)

**Done when.** Slides cover problem, hypothesis, architecture, live demonstration, evaluation result, process evidence and individual roles; 2 timed rehearsals within 10 % of the allotted time (duration to obtain from the professor); a backup video of at most 3 minutes plays offline; a sheet lists at least 10 expected questions with answers; each member presents a part

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required by | PF p. 1 (defense in week 14; panel vote 30 %) |
| Depends on | I4, J4 |
| Due | 2026-12-09 |
| Sprint | S1 (1 h), S4 (4 h) |
| Effort (S2 baseline) | 5 h |
| Priority | M (M must, S should) |

Sources: PF = PROYECTO_FINAL.pdf, A0 = Actividad0_Enunciado_Planteamiento.pdf, A0S = Actividad 0 slides, P1 = Practica 1. Commits of this step end with `Refs: plan K3`.
